Question: What is the saddest truth about toppers?
Answer: “What their in getting topped in a sheet of paper? If you are able to become a topper in life then show the happiness” Rude Right? This is the Exact statement of my grandfather who was a retired professor of Roorkee College (currently known as IIT Roorkee) when I showed him my 12th board result. Even I felt bad about his rude response at that time but now after so many years down the line, I somehow understand the hidden meaning. The most painful truth of few toppers is that none is present in their life to explain “Life doesn't not run on the number “ and “Success is never defined by the number”.
